subtitle: Cross the four Regions of Vale, hunt a dragon in order to fulfill your destiny and become an Ether Mage.

dragons.grimroch: Its icy scales are stone hard; only the most powerful spells can harm it.
dragons.helsang: It crawls back from every wound, it lives in the shadows as it escapes death.
dragons.rodving: Its fire breath is the last breath most mages ever draw.
dragons.vuurhast: It comes out of the storm in a flash, gone before the thunder.
